main_text.p: fi, Exod.28.19. & Numer.2.18. in Jon. ubi scribitur עין עינל.
עַנְלָא & cum præfixo בְּעַנְלָא ב Ch.& Syr.Cito, celeriter, velociter, festinanter.
עַגּוֹל Ch.Circulus, globus, massa conglobata & rotunda panis, Exo.29.23. in Jon. Hinc German. Kugel, Solet enim y aliquando mutari in p.
עָנַם Ch. Contristatus, Anxius fuit, ut Hebr. Job. 30.25. Dicitur & אנם.
עָנַן Ch. Detineri, retineri. Pahel עַנֵּן Detinere, Retinere.
עֲנָנָה Ch.Detentio, Inclusio: בית עֲנָנָה Domus detentionis, Carcer, Jesa.24.22.
עָרָא עֲרָה Ch. Transire, pertransire, præterire, recedere: Sic & Syr. Part. Spiritus transit super eum, juxta Tremell. Luc.9.39.

Reg. Spiritus arripit eum. Quæ transeunt, 1.Pet.1.6. Sic Act. 20.19. ubi Guido explicat, Quæ conceptæ fuerunt. Crinesius exponit Testari, conte-stari, sed locis citatis ille sensus non quadrat: Item Ch. Spoliare, dispoliare, prædari. Aphel אַעְרָא Recedere facere, amovere, removere, auferre, transferre; Sic & Syr. Act.24.7. Item Concipere, Jud.13.7. Pahel עֲרֵי Amovere: Spoliare, prædari: Concipere, Gravida fieri. Ithpahel אִתְעֲרָא Amoveri, aufferri.
עַד Ch.& Syr.Usque, Usq; ad, Donec dum, Usquedū, Adhuc. Variis particulis jungitur in utraque lingua,

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek-like and Aramaic (Chaldaic/Syriac) type is transcribed approximately; the Syriac forms and some vocalised Hebrew words are doubtful. The pointing on several Hebrew words is hard to read exactly. Several Syriac words in the Part. line are illegible at this resolution. Line 'gua,' at the foot is a catchword-like continuation of 'lingua,' and is kept as printed.
